svg.title: Harsh Gorjiwala — founder building vertical SaaS products in Hamilton, Ontario
svg.desc: Light hero with soft colour orbs, a floating glass navigation capsule, the headline “One backbone. Many products.”, and a mock of a pharmacy inbox console with a glass icon rail, neutral segmented control, opaque list and a toast.
svg.text: Founder in Hamilton, Ontario. I build vertical SaaS —
Klinova, SignProof, PartTrace and PolicyPulse — on one
shared backbone for auth, signing, storage and payments.
